item.title: NY increasing patrols, sobriety checkpoints for Big Game
item.description: ALBANY, N.Y. (NEWS10) -- Law enforcement across New York State is increasing patrols in anticipation of celebrations for the Big Game. The enforcement campaign began on Feb. 3 and runs through Feb. 8. State troopers and local police will increase their presence and sobriety checkpoints in an effort to deter, identify, and arrest impaired drivers. [...]

item.title: New York mulls moratorium on new data centers
item.description: New York state lawmakers have proposed a bill to pause the construction of new data centers for three years to study the environmental and economic impact of AI technology.

item.title: Governor Hochul signs Medical Aid in Dying Act
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed the Medical in Dying Act into law on Friday, according to a statement from Assemblywoman Amy Paulin, which she also sponsored.

item.title: FBI reviewing new message tied to Nancy Guthrie's apparent abduction
item.description: Tucson TV station KOLD said on Friday it received a new message, via email, tied to the Guthrie case. The station said it couldn’t disclose its contents.

item.title: A weekend with sub-zero feel like temperatures
item.description: ELMIRA, N.Y. (WETM)- Light snow continues at time overnight and at times tomorrow before noon. Temperatures can drop as low as negative 2 degrees overnight. A strong cold front passes through overnight, brining arctic air and stronger winds gusting upwards of 30 mph. Tomorrow, partly cloudy skies are expected with temperatures only near 5 degrees. [...]
